outcome: Maternal morbidity (febrile morbidity, disseminated intravascular coagulation)
cohort: 56 women who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy at Kasturba Hospital, New Delhi
finding: The overall incidence of emergency obstetric hysterectomy was 83 per 100,000 deliveries, with atonic postpartum hemorrhage being the most common indication, and maternal mortality was 17.7% while perinatal mortality was 37.5%.
mod_finding: The incidence of emergency obstetric hysterectomy was 30 per 100,000 following vaginal delivery and 270 per 100,000 following cesarean section.
